tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Warm plaster. Page and screen background.

tokens.name: coupon
tokens.usage: Paper: coupons, rows, panels, sheets. It sits on the plaster.

tokens.name: stub
tokens.usage: The stub below the perforation, and hover on rows.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Inputs and inset fields.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Indigo. All running text, titles and strong rules.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Field labels, captions, secondary lines. Passes 4.5:1 on all four grounds.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Indigo hairlines that structure the page and a coupon: field boxes, head rules, the perforation.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Separators between rows. Decorative only.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The action and value ink, now indigo; the name is kept so every screen keeps working. Figures, the current tab, selection, the caret and the one primary action. Never saffron: it fails on plaster.

tokens.name: amber-bright
tokens.usage: Hover on the action fill and on tabs.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text on the action fill.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Verified, sponsored. Deep green, always a word in a stamp.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Blocked, cancelled, refused. Deep madder: a word in a stamp, an error line, the danger outline, the invalid input and the out-of-band mark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, 2px offset.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: First voice of the chord. Ribbons and colour bands.

tokens.name: madder
tokens.usage: Second voice of the chord. Ribbons and colour bands; refused and voided coupons.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Third voice of the chord. Ribbons, colour bands and the pending stamp. Fill only, with indigo text on top; never text on plaster.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Slides and the catalog only. Uppercase.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Coupon titles and console screen titles. Uppercase.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sheet titles and section heads. Uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tus tokens quedan en tu billetera hasta que alguien acepte.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Atestaciones de demostración en Fuji, sin verificación de identidad.
styles.usage: Helper lines and disclaimers, in text-muted.

styles.name: field-label
styles.usage: Small wide-tracked labels for everything secondary. Uppercase, text-muted.

styles.name: figure-l
styles.usage: The one headline figure on a screen.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside stamps, and between a label and its figure.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Field padding and tight groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside a field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Coupon padding, phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding in the console.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between major blocks on desktop.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs. Coupons stay square: they are cut stock.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The bottom sheet only.

tokens.name: ease-tear
tokens.usage: The tear and the stamp.

tokens.name: duration-state
tokens.usage: Hover and focus.

tokens.name: duration-tear
tokens.usage: The stub tearing on a fill and the stamp landing, once. The ribbons drift in over 2.5 times this.
